title: Block Reset Quiet Hands (Michelle Grogan)
style: fast phonk progressive trance heavy bongo bass guitar 134bpm pickleball training high energy English Spanish coach calls no slow sections
lyrics:
[Intro]
Fast ball coming at the kitchen line
Block it soft, quiet hands, hold the line

[Verse 1]
Fast ball at the kitchen, no time to load
Paddle out front, take the quiet road
No swing, no backswing, just contact holds
Quiet hands block, the story unfolds

Paddle face slightly open at contact point
Absorb the pace, do not add to it joint
Ball drops soft just over the net tape
Block reset quiet hands, no escape

[Pre-Chorus]
No swing, paddle out front
Contact absorbs, no added stunt
Face open, ball drops low
Block reset, quiet hands go

[Chorus]
Block reset quiet hands, absorb the pace
Paddle face open, hold your space
No backswing, contact only
Block reset quiet hands, steadily

[Verse 2]
The quiet hands block is all about contact angle
Open face sends the ball low, no tangle
Closed face sends it long out of the court
Open and soft, that is the short report

[Bridge]
Bluey: No swing at all, pure block with quiet hands, beautiful composure
Trevor: The contact absorption removes approximately eighty percent of incoming ball pace
Michelle: Still. Quiet. Open face. Let the ball do the work.

[Chorus]
Block reset quiet hands, absorb the pace
Paddle face open, hold your space
No backswing, contact only
Block reset quiet hands, steadily

[Outro]
Still
Quiet
Open face
Block reset quiet hands
